Who We Are
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
 About This Role
 We are seeking a Python & Django Backend Software Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team in Romania. You will design, build and maintain modern, scalable server-side applications, RESTful APIs and data-access layers using Python and Django , working within a microservices architecture.
You will contribute across the development lifecycle, from solution and system design through development, testing, deployment and maintenance. The role also involves integrating databases, third-party services and other systems, while supporting the gradual decomposition and re-platforming of monolithic applications into microservices.
Alongside hands-on engineering, you will provide technical consultancy, contribute to technical decisions and best practices, and support colleagues through mentoring, documentation and knowledge-transfer activities.
 What You Will Do
Design, develop and maintain high-quality, well-tested back-end services and RESTful APIs using Python and Django 
Build and maintain microservices and integrations with relational databases, search and logging infrastructure, other systems and third-party services 
Contribute to the gradual decomposition of monolithic applications into microservices in line with the organisation's established microservices reference architecture 
Translate business requirements into back-end service and component designs that address scalability, security and performance 
Work with front-end developers to define and integrate API contracts 
Collaborate with product managers and other stakeholders to support successful and timely delivery 
Contribute to planning, solution design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing maintenance 
Review peer code for quality, performance and adherence to agreed coding standards 
Debug and troubleshoot technical issues and identify appropriate solutions 
Improve application performance through caching, query optimisation and efficient data-access techniques 
Apply and promote engineering practices including version control, code reviews and continuous integration 
Document code, APIs, microservices and service architecture, including technical specifications and diagrams 
Identify technical risks within service designs and propose appropriate mitigations 
Contribute to the evaluation of tools, frameworks and technologies and provide input into the team's technology stack 
Support the onboarding of new colleagues by preparing and delivering knowledge-transfer sessions 
Build technical redundancy across the team by creating, sharing and explaining documentation, operating procedures and solution or architecture designs 
Provide technical support, mentoring and guidance to colleagues across different levels of experience 
Contribute to relevant team, departmental and organisational initiatives, including technical investigations, analysis, process documentation and knowledge sharing 
 Who You Are
You have 5+ years of back-end development experience, with a strong focus on Python and Django 
You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or have equivalent practical experience 
You have strong practical proficiency in Python and the Django framework 
You have experience designing and developing RESTful APIs 
You have experience working with relational databases and SQL 
You understand microservices architecture, distributed systems, design patterns and integration patterns, with practical experience contributing to migrations from monolithic applications to microservices 
You are comfortable working with version-control systems and build tools 
You understand Agile/Scrum ways of working and can contribute effectively within collaborative, fast-moving environments 
You bring effective problem-solving skills, attention to detail and an ability to manage multiple priorities 
You can explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
You actively develop and expand your technical knowledge 
 Nice to have:
Understanding of containerisation technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes 
Experience with message brokers and asynchronous or background processing 
Familiarity with observability practices, including logging, metrics and tracing 
Experience using testing frameworks 
Experience with CI/CD pipelines 
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Microsoft Azure 
 Not a Perfect Fit?
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
 What’s In It For You
Hybrid way of working
Medical and dental services
Life and hospitalization insurance
Dedicated employee phone subscription
Take control of your benefits and choose any of the below options: MEAL TICKETS/ PRIVATE PENSION/ VACATION VOUCHERS/ CULTURAL VOUCHERS within the budget 
Special discounts for gyms and retailers
Annual Company Bonus
Loyalty Programme
Ongoing Education – we continuously invest in you to ensure you have everything needed to excel on the job and enhance your skills
You get to work with tried and trusted web-technology
Getting in on the ground floor of a technology changing company
We let you write your own story by planning vacations: go for a trip, experience new things, have fun and enjoy your 23 days off 
Special Paternal Program - 4 months of paid paternity leave
 What Skills You Will Learn
Designing scalable Python and Django back-end services 
RESTful API and service-contract design 
Microservices architecture and distributed systems 
Monolith-to-microservices migration and re-platforming approaches 
Database access, SQL optimisation, caching and application performance 
Service integration and integration patterns 
Technical risk identification and mitigation 
Architecture documentation and technical specifications 
Code review, testing and continuous integration practices 
Technical consultancy and communication with non-technical stakeholders 
Mentoring, knowledge transfer and technical documentation 
Depending on project exposure, containerisation, observability, CI/CD and cloud technologies
